articles.title: NASA X-Ray Mission Gets Fresh Look at 2,000-Year-Old Supernova
articles.summary: NASA’s IXPE (Imaging X-ray Polarimetry Explorer) mission has taken a new observation of a supernova, RCW 86, helping fill in a fuller picture of what other telescopes have observed. articles.title: Moog taps Redwire to provide solar arrays for Meteor
articles.summary:
WASHINGTON — Redwire announced the first award for its new solar arrays, a $12.8 million contract from Moog. Under the contract announced March 24, Redwire will deliver Extensible Low-Profile Solar Array  (ELSA) wings for Moog’s Meteor satellite bus ordered by an undisclosed national security customer.
